[[☃ explanation 2]]

$\dfrac{2}{1+n^2}$ satisfies the conditions for the integral test.

This means that $\displaystyle\sum\limits_{n=1}^{\infty} \dfrac{2}{1+n^2}$ converges/diverges together with $\displaystyle\int_1^{\infty} \dfrac{2}{1+x^2} \,dx$.

options.explanation:
Suppose $a_n=f(n)$ and $f$ is positive, continuous, and decreasing for $x\geq N$, the integral test says that

$\displaystyle\sum\limits_{n=N}^{\infty}a_n$ and $\displaystyle\int_N^{\infty}f(x)dx$

either both converge or both diverge.
